name: MagFlow
full_name: MagFlow flow-driven magnetic microcatheter + OmniMag steering platform
group: Sakar, EPFL (with Mosimann, Toronto Western Hospital)
target_anatomy: distal cerebral / spinal arteries, porcine model
devices_driven: inflatable flat-tube microcatheter, head width 150-250 um; fed through a 2.7 Fr (0.7 mm lumen) delivery microcatheter inside a 5 Fr guide catheter
n_dof_detail: OmniMag: spherical rotor with permanent magnet oriented by three orthogonal coils, mounted on a collaborative robot arm
translation_detail: other: blood-flow carried; no pushed shaft
validation_detail: porcine in vivo under X-ray; six branches repeatedly steered in vertebral region; navigated 180 um arteries and a 500 um hairpin with 0.69 mm radius; superselective contrast and embolic infusion
key_numbers: OmniMag 3.7 mT at 2 A, 1.7 N m torque on the magnet; average field during steering 5.7 +/- 1.4 mT; arteries as small as 180 um; min curvature radius 0.69 mm
